context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss about corporate culture
purpose: Teach: 入金/返品/善意/純正/上旬/室長/命題/広範

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、私も経理室長として、毎日入金確認に追われていたよ。
lines.en: When I was young, I was constantly chasing payment confirmations as accounting section chief.
lines.style: Calm, reflective tone with a warm, mentoring quality from an experienced elder.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: そうでしたか。実は来月上旬、返品ポリシーの全面見直しを任されまして、正直、頭が痛いんです。
lines.en: I see. Actually, early next month I've been tasked with overhauling the return policy, and honestly, my head hurts.
lines.style: Younger executive, slightly stressed but respectful, conversational mid-pitch delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ポリシーも大事だが、本当の命題は『お客様の善意をどう守るか』だと私は思う。
lines.en: Policies matter, but the real question is how you protect the goodwill of your customers, I believe.
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful pacing with gentle gravitas, emphasizing key philosophical points.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 善意、ですか。最近は純正部品の偽物まで返品されてきて、現場が荒れていまして…。
lines.en: Goodwill, huh. Lately, even fake versions of genuine parts are being returned, and the floor is in chaos.
lines.style: Frustrated but composed, slight downward intonation showing weariness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そういう時こそ、現場の声を広範に聞くんだ。机の上だけでは、文化は育たないよ。
lines.en: Times like that are when you must listen broadly to the voices on the floor; culture doesn't grow at a desk.
lines.style: Firm but kind, slightly slower delivery emphasizing each phrase for impact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 確かに、私は会議室にこもりすぎていたかもしれません。明日、現場を回ってみます。
lines.en: Indeed, I may have been holed up in the conference room too much. Tomorrow, I'll walk the floor.
lines.style: Sincere realization, softer and slightly humbled in tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: それでいい。人を信じる文化が会社を強くする。利益はあとから付いてくるものだ。
lines.en: That's the spirit. A culture that trusts people makes a company strong; profit follows later.
lines.style: Warm, paternal close with measured confidence and a hint of nostalgia.
